copy.html:
We’re giving you a 33% Rewards Balance bonus on all cash purchases — meaning every time you play, you’re stacking extra value on top.

Buy €30 worth of tickets?
You get €10 in Rewards Balance back.

Play More... Play More!

It’s simple, automatic, and designed to give you more firepower for the jackpots lighting up the week. And what a week to launch it.

Massive jackpots are in play across the board — the kind of prizes that make you sit up, lean in, and think about what life could look like with a win that big. With your balance boosted by 33%, you can take bigger swings, add more lines, and put yourself in the running with confidence.

🚀 The Formula is Simple: The more you Play, the more you get!

Don't Miss the Chance!

This is your chance to:

  • Stretch your balance further
  • Load up on entries for the biggest draws
  • Chase the wins that actually move the needle
Every purchase. Every time. More Rewards. Automatically.

Use it or Lose it!

But this boost won’t be around for long. Once it’s gone, so is the extra value. Your account is ready — go make the most of it while it’s live.

Terms and Conditions Apply::

  • Rewards Balance is paid on all cash purchases made during the promotional period.
  • Rewards Balance is not earned on tickets purchased using Rewards Balance.
  • Rewards Balance is added after the promotion closes on the 30th April and can be used for gameplay only (not withdrawable).
  • This promotion is standalone and not connected to any other offers.
  • Standard site rules and account requirements apply.

Start Playing & Get Your Rewards Now!


Start Playing!

The promotion runs until Thursday 30th April at 23:59 GMT. For full terms and conditions of the Rewards Giveaway, please visit the promotion's terms and conditions page.
